Generated Narrative: CodeSystem speiro-unit-check-fact

This case-sensitive code system https://fhir.speirotech.net/CodeSystem/speiro-unit-check-fact defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
unit-window-result Unit window resultThe supplied outcome of one source window in its selected service segment; not a payable unit or newly computed window.
unit-index Unit indexThe positive source window index within its own segment, not a document-wide identity.
service-context Service contextThe original supported service-context string for this unit, including rbt_direct_supervised_overlap when supplied; no supervision verdict.
original-reason Original reasonA supported sanitized original source reason for this result, not an independently proven exception or newly governed outcome.
consent-evidence-check Canonical consent evidence checkThe broad canonical consent-evidence check outcome; it does not establish the precise consent_missing or consent_withdrawn finding, genuine absence, pre-Start withdrawal, or first-Start per-purpose permission.
credential-snapshot-check Credential snapshot checkThe canonical provider credential-snapshot check; passed may mean snapshot present, not current license verification.
timing-continuity-check Timing continuity checkThe canonical evidence coverage/continuity result for the stated scope; not attendance, treatment or payment eligibility.
sealed-frame-sequence-check Sealed frame sequence checkThe canonical sealed-frame sequence result; recovered gap, unresolved gap and conflicting histories remain distinguishable through their original reasons.
